text:
Holly: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A. Sales needs one liner and CS wants rollback details for: model pinning + rollout UI, Optimize suggestions/export/apply, streaming+function-calls GA ETA.

Diego: Short timeline: rollout UI -> internal canary early Aug, public beta late Aug, GA only after canary (aiming late Aug). Optimize console suggestions -> preview Sept; export/API + opt-in apply -> late Sept/early Oct. Streaming+function-calls -> feature-flag GA in ~4-6 weeks. Ill post a short RFC tonight.

Sam: Infra note: rollout depends on session-slice fix (ENG-2901). If that delays, public beta slides ~1-2 weeks. Debug snippet: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/session-slice | grep "rebalance"`. Ping me for logs.

Priya: Customer-friendly blurb (copy/paste): "Planned windows: rollout UI late August (beta first), Optimize preview in September with export and opt-in apply to follow, streaming+function-calls reaching feature-flag GA in ~4-6 weeks. Exact GA dates will be shared after canary and QA." Use month-level windows only.

Diego: Rollback summary for CS: rollout UI gated by per-org flags and automated fallback to last-known-good model if p50 latency or error rate exceeds thresholds for 5 minutes. RFC will include PromQLs and dashboards.

Holly: Great. Once RFC is up, please tag docs, CS, and product so we can prep emails and FAQ.

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2024-08-03 -> 2024-08-10. Link: <https://redwood.internal/releases/1840000000|canary-resv> :spiral_calendar:
